facts.raw_span: A 67-year-old woman
31-year history of recurrent depressive disorder
depressed mood, anhedonia, nervousness, fatigue, decreased appetite, and poor sleep
beginning 5 months after COVID-19
two severe episodes responsive to escitalopram (up to 20 mg/d) and duloxetine (up to 60 mg/d)
intolerance to venlafaxine, bupropion, and trazodone
mother had mania
denied iron deficiency anemia, hypothyroidism, or substance abuse
Physical and neurologic examinations and routine laboratory tests were unremarkable
new deep itching and creeping sensations in her bilateral shoulders and arms
worse at rest, partially relieved by movement, and predominantly occurring in the evening
causing night-time sleep disturbance

concepts.why: Patient has a 31-year history of recurrent depressive disorder with depressive symptoms and has responded to antidepressants in the past
Patient developed new deep itching and creeping sensations in her bilateral shoulders and arms after increasing duloxetine dosage
Patient experienced new deep itching and creeping sensations in her bilateral shoulders and arms while taking escitalopram
Patient has a history of recurrent depressive disorder and has not responded to multiple antidepressants
Patient experienced new deep itching and creeping sensations in her bilateral shoulders and arms, which could be related to medication side effects
Patient has been experiencing persistent pain and discomfort in her bilateral shoulders and arms
Patient has a history of nervousness and has experienced anxiety symptoms
Patient has been experiencing poor sleep and nighttime sleep disturbance

rationales.F02: Long history of depressive disorder increases likelihood of Major Depressive Disorder
rationales.F03: Depressed mood and anhedonia are characteristic symptoms of Major Depressive Disorder
rationales.F05: Previous response to escitalopram and duloxetine suggests effectiveness of these medications for Major Depressive Disorder
rationales.F06: Intolerance to multiple medications increases likelihood of Treatment-Resistant Depression
rationales.F10: New onset of deep itching and creeping sensations suggests Duloxetine-Induced Neuropathic Pain or Escitalopram-Induced Pruritus
rationales.F12: Night-time sleep disturbance is a characteristic symptom of Sleep Disorder
